derivation: or תַּחְבּוּלָה; from H2254 (חָבַל) as denominative from H2256 (חֶבֶל);
def: (only in plural) properly, steerage (as a management of ropes), i.e. (figuratively) guidance or (by implication) a plan

occurrences.text: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.
Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
